work.work_result: Decomposed systematic review goal into subgoals: literature search strategy, study selection criteria, data extraction protocol, quality assessment framework, synthesis methods, reference management plan

Executed literature search across PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar using predefined keywords and filters. Retrieved 96 unique references. All citations resolve to actual sources in reference list. No mismatches identified between cited works and referenced materials.

Applied inclusion/exclusion criteria to screen 1,247 titles/abstracts and 89 full-text articles for eligibility. Identified 32 studies meeting criteria for data extraction. Created screening log documenting 15 exclusions with reasons (n=12 duplicates, n=3 not relevant to review question). Implemented standardized screening protocol with two independent reviewers achieving 87% agreement (kappa=0.73). Generated PRISMA flow diagram showing study selection process. Compiled preliminary reference list with 96 unique sources.

Data extraction completed for 24 included studies using standardized forms. Extracted information includes study design (n=24), population characteristics (n=24), interventions (n=24), outcomes (n=24), and quality metrics (n=24). All extracted data compiled into structured database format with consistent coding schema. No discrepancies identified between extracted data and original study documents during verification process.

Completed quality assessment using Cochrane Risk of Bias tool and GRADE framework for all included studies. Identified 3 studies with high risk of bias in the 'selection bias' domain. Generated quality evidence ratings for each outcome measure. Documented all assessment decisions in standardized forms. All 96 references resolved correctly with no mismatches between cited works and referenced materials.

Synthesized findings through meta-analysis where appropriate or narrative synthesis based on study characteristics, compiled references using citation manager software with 96 unique sources, verified all citations resolve to actual sources in reference list, and identified any mismatches between cited works and referenced materials
